summary.text: Jason Griffith is the Republican candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 77 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat George A. Brown Jr.
Griffith works in manufacturing and was the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Jason Griffith ran for Kentucky House District 77 in 2024, when the Republican primary was canceled and he advanced to the general election.
Incumbent George A. Brown Jr. defeated him in the general election, 72.5% to 27.5%.
The Republican primary for the seat was canceled again in 2026, and Griffith advanced to the general election without appearing on the ballot.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Griffith said he had worked for Toyota Motor Manufacturing of Kentucky for 21 years and had volunteered with the Police Activity League, mentoring children.
He said he served as chairman of the Kentucky chapter of the National Parents Organization and played a role in the passage of House Bill 528, which concerns shared parenting in custody cases.
He listed building stronger families, creating resources for families and fostering flourishing communities as his campaign messages.
